environment.description: Container deployed via Kubernetes with pod security context specifying readOnlyRootFilesystem: true. No emptyDir, hostPath, or PVC volumes are mounted. The container image uses a distroless base with no shell. The pod spec does NOT include any writable tmpfs mount. The OCI runtime spec has rootfs propagation set to 'rprivate' with no additional mount points. Container uses runtime class 'gvisor' (runsc) which enforces VFS restrictions independently of the Linux mount namespace.
